result.summary: The "3+ reminders" alert (event 020) is system noise. Cedar Homes had already replied in event 019 to say the job was complete, so the reminders went out by mistake. I moved the ticket on to close-out. I asked Cedar Homes to resend the invoice, which I can't see in the records, and asked the tenant to confirm the window handle works. There's a hold with a 3-day follow-up. I didn't escalate: the contractor and tenant can answer the open questions themselves.

judgement.why_this_decision: The landlord said 'Please go ahead' (event 012) when asked if a contractor could fit a new handle (event 009). Cedar Homes was assigned and briefed (events 013–016). Noah Ellis of Cedar Homes reported the job complete on 2025-02-11 (event 019), after the automated reminders in events 017–018. The next alert (event 020) is therefore noise: the provider has already responded. The ticket was still in 'scheduling', which was behind the evidence, so I moved it to close-out. Two things are still open. The invoice isn't visible, so I asked the contractor to resend it. The tenant hasn't confirmed the fix, so I asked them. Both can answer directly, so there was no need for a human.
